ui.setup_username_hint: 3 to 32 characters: letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.

ui.setup_public_url_locked: Not editable here: the .env file is not mounted in the container.
ui.setup_public_url_warning: The domain will change. You will need to restart the stack, then sign in again at this address: the current session is tied to the old domain.
ui.setup_public_url_hint: Address the PACS will be reached at. Leave as is to stay local; can be changed later from the panel.
ui.setup_missing_password: a password of at least 12 characters
ui.setup_done_restart: Restart the stack to apply the new domain:
ui.users_created: User created. Authelia will pick it up within a few seconds.
ui.orthanc_note: Edits orthanc.json directly. A backup is created before each write. Changes only take effect after Orthanc restarts, using the button below.
ui.orthanc_restart_pending: Waiting for a restart to take effect
ui.orthanc_restart_confirm: Restart Orthanc? Ongoing viewing sessions and transfers will be interrupted for about thirty seconds.
ui.api_unreachable: Cannot reach the server ({path}). Check that the stack is running and that the certificate for {origin} is accepted by the browser. Technical detail: {detail}
ui.api_session_expired: Session expired or insufficient rights. Sign in again, and check that the account belongs to the “admin” group.
ui.api_unexpected_response: Unexpected response from the server (HTTP {status}, non-JSON content). The URL {path} was most likely caught by a redirect.
ui.network_note: Address browsers use to reach the PACS, port included. It drives redirects, session cookies and the certificate.
ui.network_confirm: Changing the public address requires restarting the stack and signing in again at the new address. Continue?
ui.network_saved: Address saved. Restart the stack to apply, then sign in again at the new address.
ui.network_readonly: The .env file is not reachable: the address cannot be changed from the panel.
ui.langue_note: Language of the panel and share pages. Changing it reloads the page.
ui.backups_note: Created automatically before every write to the Orthanc configuration or the user list. The last ten are kept.
ui.backup_confirm: Restore “{name}”? The current file will be backed up before being replaced.
ui.audit_note: The last 200 events: accounts, Orthanc configuration, restored backups and requests rejected for security reasons.
ui.modalities_note: Equipment this server exchanges studies with: scanners, MRI, post-processing workstations. Declarations take effect immediately, without a restart.
ui.modality_aet_help: 16 characters maximum, imposed by the DICOM standard
ui.cfg_Name_help: Shown in the interface and announced to other equipment.
ui.cfg_DicomAet_help: Name of this node on the DICOM network. Sixteen characters maximum, as the standard requires.
ui.cfg_DicomServerEnabled_help: Reception of studies sent by modalities (DIMSE protocol, dedicated port).
ui.cfg_DicomCheckCalledAet_help: Rejects connections that do not explicitly address this server.
ui.cfg_DicomAlwaysAllowEcho_help: Answers connectivity checks (C-ECHO), even from unknown equipment.
ui.cfg_DicomAlwaysAllowStore_help: Accepts studies (C-STORE) from undeclared equipment. Leave off when all modalities are known.
ui.cfg_DicomAlwaysAllowFind_help: Answers search requests (C-FIND) from undeclared equipment.
ui.cfg_DicomAlwaysAllowMove_help: Answers transfer requests (C-MOVE) from undeclared equipment.
ui.cfg_DicomScpTimeout_help: Drops a DICOM association left without an answer.
ui.cfg_DicomThreadsCount_help: Number of DICOM associations handled in parallel.
ui.cfg_SynchronousCMove_help: Waits for the transfer to finish before answering, instead of handling it in the background.
ui.cfg_DicomModalitiesInDatabase_help: Stores declared equipment in the database rather than the configuration file, so it survives a rewrite of the latter.
ui.cfg_OrthancPeersInDatabase_help: Same principle for other declared Orthanc servers.
ui.cfg_RemoteAccessAllowed_help: Without this, only the local host can reach the interface. The proxy runs in another container, so turning it off cuts all access.
ui.cfg_HttpPort_help: Orthanc's internal port. The proxy connects to it; changing it means adapting the proxy configuration.
ui.cfg_HttpTimeout_help: Drops a web request left without an answer.
ui.cfg_HttpCompressionEnabled_help: Compresses responses. Leave on except on a very fast network with a limited processor.
ui.cfg_StorageCompression_help: Reduces disk usage at the cost of processor time on every read and write.
ui.cfg_MaximumStorageSize_help: 0 for no limit. Beyond it, behaviour depends on the mode below.
ui.cfg_MaximumStorageMode_help: Recycle deletes the oldest studies; Reject refuses new ones.
ui.cfg_StoreMD5ForAttachments_help: Computes a checksum on write to detect later corruption.
ui.cfg_OverwriteInstances_help: Behaviour when a study already present is sent again.
ui.cfg_StableAge_help: Time without a new image after which a study is considered complete. Automated processing relies on it.
ui.cfg_DicomWeb_Enable_help: Protocol used by web viewers (OHIF, Stone). Disabling it prevents them from displaying studies.
ui.cfg_DicomWeb_Root_help: Root of the DICOMweb API on the Orthanc side.
ui.cfg_DicomWeb_PublicRoot_help: Root announced to clients, as it appears behind the proxy.
ui.cfg_DicomWeb_EnableWado_help: Older retrieval protocol, still expected by some tools.
ui.cfg_DicomWeb_EnableMetadata_help: Lets viewers read tags without downloading the images.
ui.cfg_DicomWeb_StowMaxInstances_help: Maximum number of images accepted in a single DICOMweb submission. 0 for no limit.
ui.cfg_IngestTranscoding_help: Converts incoming images to a given transfer syntax. Leave empty to keep the original format.
ui.cfg_IngestTranscodingOfUncompressed_help: Only has an effect if transcoding is configured above.
ui.cfg_DefaultEncoding_help: Character set assumed when a study does not specify one. Latin1 in Western Europe.
ui.cfg_AcceptedTransferSyntaxes_help: Image formats accepted on reception. One value per line.
ui.cfg_ConcurrentJobs_help: Number of operations run in parallel (sends, exports, anonymisations).
ui.cfg_JobsHistorySize_help: Number of finished tasks kept in memory.
ui.cfg_SaveJobs_help: Unfinished tasks resume at the next start.
ui.cfg_LimitFindResults_help: Cap on the number of studies returned by a search. 0 for no limit.
ui.cfg_LimitFindInstances_help: Same cap at the image level.
ui.cfg_LogLevel_help: default, verbose or trace. High levels produce a lot of volume.
ui.cfg_DeidentifyLogs_help: Removes patient identifiers from the logs. Leave on: logs are often shared during troubleshooting.
ui.users_last_admin_locked: Last active administrator: neither editing nor deletion is possible. Create a second administrator to unlock.
ui.err_public_url_https: the public URL must start with https://
ui.err_public_url_host: missing host in the public URL
ui.err_file_locked: file locked by another administrator, retry in 5s
ui.err_cannot_delete_self: you cannot delete your own account
ui.err_backup_not_found: backup not found, or invalid name
ui.err_authelia_corrupt: users_database.yml is corrupt: {detail}. Restore a backup with POST /api/admin/backups/restore.
ui.err_orthanc_json_corrupt: orthanc.json is corrupt: {detail}. Restore a backup with POST /api/admin/backups/restore.
